method: Sentinel-2 SR: MNDWI > 0.1 in >= 50% of clear post-event scenes and <= 20% of clear pre-event scenes
exclusions: JRC permanent water (>80% occurrence) and slope > 5.0 deg
note: Observed flood flag is a remote-sensing proxy (residual standing water on the scene dates, clouds and urban flooding under-detected). Unobserved assets are excluded from every rate.
